text_block_list.text:
Race day. They meet a Trainer who once 
managed an Umamusume very similar to 
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute headed into the race with a 
burning heart, knowing that the people who 
supported her each carried their own 
cherished feelings.
